name: Chung Fu Tex-International Corporation
summary: Chung Fu Tex-International Corporation operates a diverse business portfolio, primarily focused on real estate, including the development, leasing, and sale of various properties. Beyond its activities in the housing and building sector, the company also engages in the retail of tobacco and alcoholic products, and offers warehousing solutions. Founded in 1960, the enterprise transitioned from its former name, Chung Fu Zhenye Co., Ltd., to Chung Fu Tex-International Corporation in July 2010. Its main office is situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
